writtenTo: The church in Ephesus (and possibly a circular letter)
importantNotes: 'By grace you have been saved, through faith — not by works' (2:8-9) — the gospel in a nutshell.
The 'armor of God' passage (6:10-18) is the classic teaching on spiritual warfare.
Ephesians describes the church as Christ's body, bride, building, and army.
'Now to him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine' (3:20).
The letter's structure: chapters 1-3 (what God has done) → chapters 4-6 (how we should live).

chapters.1: Every spiritual blessing in Christ; chosen, adopted, redeemed; Paul's prayer for wisdom.
chapters.2: Dead in sin, made alive by grace; saved by grace through faith; Jew and Gentile united.
chapters.3: The mystery revealed — Gentiles are co-heirs with Israel; Paul's prayer for strength.
chapters.4: Walk worthy of your calling; unity of the body; put off the old self, put on the new.
chapters.5: Walk in love, light, and wisdom; be filled with the Spirit; marriage as Christ and the church.
chapters.6: Children and parents; slaves and masters; the full armor of God for spiritual battle.
